title: UsaBanner configuration
description: Every setting of a host's banners, in one file. A key left out takes its value from defaults.json.

version.description: The shape of this file. It goes up only when a file written for the old shape would be read wrongly.

company.description: The company name, for 'Welcome to <company>'. It shows before login, so printable ASCII only, and short enough for the 64-column box.

environment.description: The tier the host belongs to. UNSET takes the tier from the host's AD Description, as "PROD : Web front end" gives PROD; with none there, it draws a grey badge.

role.description: What the host is for, in a few words, shown after login. Empty takes the role from the host's AD Description, as "PROD : Web front end" gives Web front end.

name.description: A built-in piece of art, by name. 'os' is our pictogram in the host's OS colour; 'os-logo' is the logo of the OS the host runs.

custom.description: Art of your own, as New-UsaBannerArt -OutFile saves it; drawn in place of the named art. Deploy-UsaBanner -ArtPath puts a file's art here.

mode.description: This host's colour mode. auto reads the terminal's signals; anything else is what the admin found works here. USABANNER_COLOR in a user's environment overrides it.

glyphs.description: Whether the banner after login draws its lines, bars and marks in Unicode, or in ASCII for clients that are not UTF-8. auto reads the client's locale; anything else is what the admin found the clients of this host show. USABANNER_GLYPHS in a user's environment overrides it.

set.description: The box's lines and corners. Rounded, Single, Double, Heavy and Block are Unicode: after login only, with Classic before login and wherever the client is not UTF-8.

cap.description: A label centred in the top line, between the title and the hint: an ASCII face such as (^_^).

template.description: L1 (friendly) to L5 (maximum), or custom for the lines in text.

text.description: The custom legal text, one string per line. It shows before login: printable ASCII only.

voice.description: A meme voice for a lab VM: the banner's own words rewritten, never its facts. plain is no voice.

preInit.description: What the console shows before login, besides the company name and the legal text.

preLogon.description: What the SSH banner shows before authentication, besides the company name and the legal text. Anyone who starts to log in can read it.

vlans.description: The VLAN table: the post-login banner names the VLAN the host's address is in.

color.description: The colour of the VLAN's badge after login. Without one, the badge is grey.

short.description: The VLAN's name in the badge, as Servers in 'HQ - 40-Servers'. Without one, the badge shows the name.

naming.description: The naming standard host names are decoded with: <site:2><type><subtype><os>-<name><number>, so h-vsl-web1 is HQ / Virtual / Server / Linux. A name is decoded only when its type, subtype and OS are all listed; a site that is not listed shows as ?. The sites shipped are examples: list your own. An empty types list turns decoding off.

sites.description: Two characters: a site letter, then a sub-site letter or - for none.

types.description: The third character: what kind of machine it is.

subtypes.description: The fourth character: what the machine does.

os.description: The fifth character: the operating system.

services.description: The services the post-login banner watches: 'default' for the OS's own list, or the names.

update.description: The update channel (D14). off looks for nothing. notify looks for a newer release once a day, and the banner after login says when there is one. install installs it, each file checked against the release's SHA256SUMS. The job runs as root (SYSTEM): whoever can change the releases at the source can change what runs on this host.

source.description: The https address the releases' files are downloaded from: SHA256SUMS and UsaBanner-<version>.zip are found under it, as under a GitHub repository's .../releases/latest/download, or a GitLab project's .../-/releases/permalink/latest/downloads. Empty while the mode is off.

colorName.description: One of the named colours, each drawn in 24-bit colour and as its nearest of the 16 basic ones.

color.description: The colour of this code's letters in the host name after login.
The colour of this code's letter in the host name after login.
